name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching his uncle repair engines in their small village. He quickly transitioned from spectator to apprentice, learning the intricacies of vehicle maintenance and the importance of meticulous detail. Driven by a desire to combine his artistic inclinations with his technical skills, Marko specialized in paintwork, honing his craft through various apprenticeships and local racing teams.

His relentless pursuit of perfection and innovative approach to color schemes have made him a valuable asset to Caterham Motorsport. Marko believes that the paint job is not merely cosmetic but an integral part of a car's performance, influencing aerodynamics and reflecting the team's identity. He approaches each project with a blend of technical expertise and artistic flair, striving to create visually stunning and aerodynamically optimized designs. His loyalty to the team is unquestionable, viewing his colleagues as family. He is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of automotive aesthetics.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Marko is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always polishes his tools meticulously before and after use.
